eventMetadata.context_description:
**Met Office and European model consensus points to a daytime maximum of 27°C in London on August 15, 2026, under mostly sunny intervals and light northerly winds following the intense heatwave that peaked near 38°C at Kew Gardens on August 13.**

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent ensemble forecasts from European and German meteorological models indicate a transitional high-pressure regime over southern Bavaria on August 16, with southerly advection supporting afternoon maxima near 30–32 °C under mostly clear to partly cloudy skies. However, increasing atmospheric instability and modest moisture return raise the probability of scattered afternoon thundershowers, which could cap temperatures at the lower end of that range by limiting insolation and enhancing evaporative cooling. This narrow spread explains the near-even market-implied odds between 30 °C and 31 °C, with 32 °C remaining viable only if convective development is delayed or suppressed. Updated model runs and surface observations through the evening of August 15 will refine the timing of any instability, directly influencing the final observed high measured at the official Munich station.
